knowledge:
- key_parameters: coi=The cell type of interest (e.g., "Fibroblasts") used to calculate density, find ROIs, or define contours ;; group.by=The metadata column name in colData used to color cells in spatial plots ;; roi=The name of the ROI (typically matching the coi) to filter or group the analysis ;; equal.cell=A logical value indicating whether to divide contours such that they contain an equal number of cells ;; celltype1=The first cell type for correlation analysis ;; celltype2=The second cell type for correlation analysis ;; x.col=The column name for the x-coordinate in the grid density data frame ;; y.col=The column name for the y-coordinate in the grid density data frame
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: Use when you have single-cell resolution spatial transcriptomics data (e.g., Xenium, CosMx, MERFISH) and want to model cell-type-specific spatial density, identify spatial regions of interest (ROIs) based on cell density, test spatial colocalization/correlation between cell types, or analyze cell composition across density gradients.
- pitfalls: selectRegion opens an interactive shiny/plotly window which cannot be run in non-interactive or headless environments without user interaction. Ensure cell type names passed to coi, celltype1, and celltype2 match exactly with the values in the colData cell type column. corDensity requires ROIs to be defined first (via findROI or postSelRegion) if analyzing within ROIs.

workflows.name: spatial_density_and_roi_analysis
workflows.intent: Model cell density, identify regions of interest (ROIs), test cell-type colocalization, and annotate cells by density contours in spatial transcriptomics data.
input: spe.rds (SpatialExperiment object containing spatial coordinates and cell type annotations in colData)
workflows.stages: 1. Load spatial transcriptomics data as a SpatialExperiment object ;; 2. Calculate grid-based cell density using gridDensity ;; 3. Identify Regions of Interest (ROIs) either algorithmically using findROI or manually using selectRegion and postSelRegion ;; 4. Test spatial correlation/colocalization between cell types using corDensity ;; 5. Define density contours using getContour and allocate cells to these contours using allocateCells ;; 6. Visualize cell composition and spatial distributions using plotSpatial, plotDensity, plotROI, plotDensCor, plotCorHeatmap, plotContour, and plotCellCompo
workflows.code:
library(scider)
library(SpatialExperiment)
data("xenium_bc_spe")
spe
table(colData(spe)$cell_type)
plotSpatial(spe, group.by = "cell_type", pt.alpha = 0.8)
spe <- gridDensity(spe)
names(metadata(spe))
metadata(spe)$grid_density
plotDensity(spe)
plotDensity(spe, coi = "Fibroblasts")
spe <- findROI(spe, coi = "Fibroblasts")
metadata(spe)$fibroblasts_roi
plotROI(spe, roi = "Fibroblasts")
selectRegion(metadata(spe)$grid_density, x.col = "x_grid", y.col = "y_grid")
spe1 <- postSelRegion(spe, sel_region = sel_region)
metadata(spe1)$roi
plotROI(spe1)
results <- corDensity(spe, roi = "Fibroblasts")
results$ROI
results$overall
plotDensCor(spe, celltype1 = "Breast cancer", celltype2 = "Fibroblasts")
plotCorHeatmap(results$ROI)
plotCorHeatmap(results$overall)
spe <- getContour(spe, coi = "Fibroblasts", equal.cell = TRUE)
plotContour(spe, coi = "Fibroblasts")
spe <- allocateCells(spe)
plotSpatial(spe, group.by = "fibroblasts_contour", pt.alpha = 0.5)
plotCellCompo(spe, contour = "Fibroblasts")
plotCellCompo(spe, contour = "Fibroblasts", roi = "Fibroblasts")
